title: Kevda Sarbat
description: Kevda Sarbat (Pandanus Syrup) is a highly aromatic syrup infused with the distillate of Kevda (Screwpine) flowers, known for its deep cooling effect. This classical formulation lowers excessive body heat. Reduces intense thirst. Calms palpitations. Refreshes the mind.
dosage: 20–30 ml diluted in a glass of cold water or milk
